description: This file defines a final class MimeType in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, which provides methods to determine MIME types based on file extensions using a predefined static mapping. It is part of the Guzzle HTTP client library and is used to identify the MIME type of files based on filename or extension.

classes.name: MimeType
classes.description: A utility class that maps file extensions to MIME types and determines MIME types based on filename or extension.

methods.name: fromFilename
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of a file based on its filename extension.

methods.name: fromExtension
methods.description: Maps a given file extension to its MIME type using the predefined static map.
